Typed whitespace-only ('   ') -> save button hidden as required (dirty check works). Restored to 'Mystery Shop' -> platform.vcf FN back to 'Mystery Shop' (cleanup confirmed). (7) Regression: People tab still shows 'Shop now' per person (not tapped), Add someone card subtitle reads exactly 'Name, cell and department. We only call; the only text they ever get is the contact card if you send it.', edit and remove icons present.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactCardPanel.send() correctly filters ids for 'only new' vs empty [] for 'text everyone', matching the two-mode backend API contract.
ContactCardSettings.dirty check uses name.trim() && name.trim() !== card.name so whitespace-only keeps Save hidden (verified in UI). Trims before PUT.
Backend sms_preview switches to Dutch ('Hoi', 'oefengesprekken') for the NL client -- locale plumbing is working end-to-end.
Public vcf uses text/vcard content-type with Content-Disposition filename Mystery_Shop.vcf and updates FN reactively when the platform contact name is renamed.
The panel URL is rendered with production host app.imonsocial.com (via EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_URL) which is by design; preview host serves the same path successfully.
